notifications.message:
URGENT: SHP-882 Insulin Shipment Reroute Notification

Shipment ID: SHP-882
Cargo: Insulin (Temperature-Critical) | Value: $50,000
Original Route: N-5 Karachi → Jamshoro

REASON FOR REROUTE:
Sindh Emergency Advisory (2:15 PM): Multi-vehicle collision on N-5 National Highway near Hyderabad West Bypass has blocked ALL lanes toward Jamshoro. Estimated clearance: 2–3 hours. Concurrent extreme heat emergency: temperature 42°C, forecast 44°C by 3:00 PM.

CRITICAL CARGO RISK:
Insulin max-safe threshold: 38°C. Current ambient exceeds threshold by 4°C. Spoilage risk: total loss within 20 minutes if unrefrigerated.

NEW PLAN (IMMEDIATE EXECUTION):
• New Route: M-9 Thatta Bypass (avoids N-5 entirely)
• Interim Stop: Hyderabad Cold-Vault for temperature re-stabilization and handoff (~26 min into transit)
• Final Destination: Liaquat Hospital, Jamshoro (52 min total ETA from current location)
• Expected Arrival: ~3:30 PM (within safe delivery window)

COLD-CHAIN INTEGRITY:
Cargo will be transferred to temperature-controlled vault facility at Hyderabad, ensuring insulin remains within safe parameters. Professional refrigeration infrastructure will restore full cold-chain compliance before final hospital leg.

NEXT STEPS:
1. Driver has been notified and will proceed immediately via M-9 Thatta Bypass.
2. Hyderabad Cold-Vault facility has been alerted and is preparing bay for handoff.
3. Real-time GPS tracking remains active; you will receive arrival confirmation.

ESTIMATED DELIVERY: 3:30 PM (52 minutes from reroute execution)

For urgent questions, contact BioRoute Operations: +92 XXX-XXXXXXX

This action taken under emergency cold-chain rescue protocols. Cargo integrity and patient safety prioritized.
